Ashdown Engineering browse by type volume/amplification amplification preamp / clean boost browse by type volume/amplification amplification DI browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal events 2024 NAMM 2024 Ashdown Engineering Pro-DI Published on December 7, 2023 Ashdown Engineering boost / preamp DI overdrive pedal NAMM 2024 Information Ashdown Engineering Launching in September 2023, the Ashdown Pro Di is a game-changer for touring bassists. Crafted with simplicity and longevity in mind, it features a robust 5-band EQ with the Ashdown Shape option, providing versatile tonal sculpting. Drawing inspiration from Ashdown's renowned ABM, MAG, and ROOTMASTER series, this pedal guarantees a professional-grade performance when you can't rely on backline gear. The valve-emulated overdrive, complete with drive mix and level controls, ensures you won't compromise volume or gain. With input and output adjustments and a handy Ashdown VU meter, you can fine-tune your levels effortlessly. Plus, the included passive and active input sensitivity pad accommodates all basses. Whether you need a balanced front-of-house or monitor feed, the transformer-isolated Di output has you covered. A ground lift option ensures optimal performance. The pedal also features a line input with its own dedicated Line Mix control, perfect for practice or monitoring. Engineered to reduce your gear load, the Ashdown Pro Di is built to last and designed for easy repairability for years to come. It comes with Ashdown's standard 5-year warranty, making it a wise investment for bass players.
